title: pairwise-stone-space
description: A bitopological space carrying two topologies (positive- and negative-evidence) that is compact and pairwise-separated; the bitopological reframing of a Priestley space, with PStone isomorphic to Pries and to the category of spectral spaces.

positiveTopology.description: the topology tau_+ generated by positive evidence

negativeTopology.description: the topology tau_- generated by negative evidence

pairwiseSeparated.description: pairwise-separated parallel to ordinary Stone spaces but applied to both topologies simultaneously, treating tau_+ and tau_- symmetrically
